error.message: The shop system is not answering. Hand the conversation over with reason system_failure.

input.summary: Customer Cosmin Radu (cosmin.radu@example.com) asks where order SC-3127 is; says it has been two days with no update. Customer provided order number and email. lookup_order failed with an unavailable error, so the order status and tracking could not be checked.
